title: Authored waves: 1-5 Walkers, newcomers one per wave from 6
intent: Introduce Runner, Brute and Elite gradually without changing the five Walker waves the user authored

evidence.description: a full 10-wave run spawned exactly each authored wave, 110 kills and 632 coins with each reward once; banners named Runner, Brute and Elite on waves 6, 7 and 8
Current Git HEAD commit at time of record

constraints.statement: Waves 1-5 stay the user-authored Walker waves of 6, 8, 9, 9 and 9

Each new enemy type first appears alone in its own wave, in small numbers (Runner 3 in wave 6, Brute 1 in wave 7, Elite 1 in wave 8), spread through the spawn order; the first wave announces no newcomer
Enemy and weapon stats live only in the ENEMIES and WEAPONS tables; Enemy and Weapon read them

result.summary: Waves 6-10 added; uncommitted on branch weapons-and-enemies at time of record
